task: CLI pipeline orchestration resource risk review

resource_risks.description: A future multi-CLI runner could leave child processes running if cancellation and cleanup are not explicit.
resource_risks.mitigation: The pipeline contract requires timeout_policy, cancellation_policy, cleanup_policy, orphan_process_policy, and per-process timeout_seconds before execution readiness.

resource_risks.description: A future runner could hang or grow memory if stdout/stderr pipes are unbounded.
resource_risks.mitigation: The pipeline contract requires per-process max_output_bytes, pipeline max_output_bytes, and backpressure_policy.
